reasons.requirements: All seven acceptance criteria are covered in the spec and the diff, including the UTC rule, the 400 cases, and the exact UI wording.
reasons.scope: The change adds JSON-object body validation and makes a rejected PATCH atomic, which nobody asked for; the summary does disclose both and they are small.
reasons.tests: Store and API tests cover the validation, UTC boundary, filter and PATCH null cases, and no existing tests were weakened; the page behaviour (date format, marker) is only checked through a static HTML string match, and there is no test for a PATCH that is rejected without changing anything.
reasons.conventions: The change uses ValidationError mapped to 400, adds data-testid on every new UI element, uses only builtins, and writes tests first.
reasons.architecture: The overdue rule lives only in the store's view helper, and the app and page reuse it, so the logic is not duplicated.
reasons.codeQuality: The code is clean and handles edge cases such as the leap day and the PATCH ordering; the Date.parse check is redundant given the round-trip comparison, and render() has no handling for failed fetches.
